content:
Ana: FYI asking for a market-entry concession for AtlasRetail (APAC pilot). Sales wants: 25% off year-1 list, waive setup/onboarding fee $6k, and an exclusive 90-day renewal window (they want first renewal pricing guaranteed for 90 days post-pilot). Need deal-desk + RevManager + CFO eyeballs.

Ravi: Background: customer is regional integrator with potential to bring 10 similar merchants. Competitor offered 20% + free onboarding. Sales believes exclusivity helps lock partner channel.

Ben: Quick numbers: ```
List year-1 ARR: $60,000
25% off year-1 = $45,000 (delta = -$15,000)
Onboarding fee waived: $6,000
Total one-time concession = $21,000
Notes: If converted, expansion could be material but risk of revenue loss if exclusivity leads to price expectations.
```

Kelsey: That's >$15k so requires RevManager + Finance Director approval per policy. Also, exclusivity is a product/partnership risk; PartnerOps needs to sign off and legal needs exclusivity limits (geography + time).

FinanceBot: Policy check: discounts >=20% or concessions >$15k require Revenue Manager + Finance Director + legal sign-off. Please attach deal-desk form, partner commitment letter, and ROI rationale. Internal: https://intranet.redwood/finance/deal-desk-policy (internal).

Ana: Proposed guardrails: discount only applies to initial customer account(s) in APAC pilot SKU, no auto-apply to other accounts, exclusivity limited to 90 days and geographically scoped to Metro region, $25k maximum concession cap (to catch future add-ons), and a 6-month performance milestone for expansion continue. Also require partner to sign an exclusivity acknowledgement.

Ravi: Added: require customer to commit to a joint case study and minimum usage milestone by month 4 to retain eligibility for any extension. If milestone missed, pricing reverts to list and onboarding fee billed retroactively up to 50%.

Ben: I can live with that if RevManager approves and Legal drafts exclusivity appendix. Also request Exec sponsor (Head of Partnerships) sign-off.

RevOps: I'll verify projected ARR and model worst-case concession impact by 2607778850. If docs are in order, we'll route to RevManager.

Kelsey: Legal will draft a short "limited market-entry concession" appendix with exclusivity scope, credit cap, case study clause, and retro-billing language. Need Sales to upload partner commitment and SOW.

Ana: @Ravi please upload SOW + partner commitment + completed deal-desk form by 2607778800. Marking thread deal-desk:pending.

Ravi: Will upload by 2607778750 and add CRM note tag "apac-market-entry". :thumbsup:

Ana: Thanks all  want to resolve before end of week to hit Q.
